# HydrusLearn Pro

> HydrusLearn Pro is an advanced AI-powered study platform that turns your uploaded PDF notes, lecture slides, and research into targeted quizzes, grounded deep research, and metacognitive feedback with comprehensive study history. It helps students understand their material — not just memorise it.

## Product

HydrusLearn Pro is an educational web application available at https://hydruslearn.com. It is free to start with no credit card required.

**Core tools:**
- [Upload PDF](https://hydruslearn.com/signup): Upload lecture notes or PDF documents; HydrusLearn Pro processes them in seconds
- [Quiz & Calibration](https://hydruslearn.com/signup): AI-generated quiz questions drawn exclusively from your own uploaded material with confidence calibration
- [Interactive Study Lab](https://hydruslearn.com/signup): A flexible, document-grounded study space where students type what they want to review and the AI builds the best tool (flashcards, Q&A, summaries, mindmaps)
- [Mind's Mirror](https://hydruslearn.com/signup): Metacognitive analysis that identifies patterns in your mistakes so you improve how you think, not just what you remember
- [Marketplace](https://hydruslearn.com/marketplace): Discover and reuse study tools shared by other learners; fork and customise them

## Who It's For

- University and college students revising from lecture notes
- Medical, law, and science students with dense PDF material
- Anyone who wants to move from passive reading to active understanding

## Why HydrusLearn Pro vs Anki / Quizlet

Unlike Anki and Quizlet, HydrusLearn Pro generates all questions and interactive tools automatically from your own documents. You don't manually create cards. It also provides metacognitive feedback — explaining why you got something wrong and how to fix the underlying cognitive gap.

## Pricing

Free tier: up to 5 document uploads per month, unlimited quizzes on uploaded content.
No credit card required to sign up.
